title: I built the platform brawler I wanted to play.
author: xKruMpeTx
selftext:
Hi friendly AI devs! This is my brain child, **CoreShard**, a 2D platform brawler I've been working on since late September. It's open for pre-registration on Google Play. I wanted to showcase it! Hope you like it!

\*\*What's in the game:\*\*

\- A story campaign. The Core that balanced the four elements has shattered, the four elemental masters are corrupted by its shards, and Kai, who has no element of his own, goes to free them, learning the elements along the way.

\- 10 unique boss fights.

\- Elements that combine (like in Spellbreak), fire through wind becomes a Firestorm, water puts out fires, fire melts ice walls ect ect.

\- Arcade mode where you brawl up to four rivals with easy, medium and hard mode.

\- Free to start, no ads.

\*\*How it was made:\*\*

\- Claude wrote the code: TypeScript, PixiJS for the rendering, Capacitor for the Android app. About 51,000 lines over 220 commits.

\- There are no audio files. The music is a chiptune score written as code (two pulse channels, a triangle bass and noise drums) and played by a small synth inside the game. The sound effects are synthesised too.

\*\*What I learned:\*\*

\- Write the rules down. The project has a CLAUDE.md with design rules like "a level looks like its name" and "no two worlds share a trick", so a new session doesn't undo old decisions.

\- Have tests that play the game. Bots walk every room to check every door can be reached, so a layout change that makes a room impossible fails before I ever see it.

\- Playtest on the real device. I was play testing on PC but realised PC was easier than thumb controls so I had to adjust difficulty for mobile play.

Take a look if you'd like.

**Pre-register**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixwren.coreshard
